cases.name: Confirmed supplier recovery date
cases.input: The disruption has a confirmed recovery date.
cases.expected: The expedite scenario removes the unconfirmed-recovery uncertainty.

cases.name: Unconfirmed recovery date
cases.input: The remaining supplier recovery date is missing.
cases.expected: The uncertainty is preserved rather than inferred.

cases.name: Partial shipment
cases.input: Supplier Alpha offers a positive partial shipment.
cases.expected: The expedite scenario is executable only when the partial quantity is positive.

cases.name: Conflicting collaboration and operational dates
cases.input: The communicated date differs from the operational date.

cases.name: Alternate supplier approved
cases.input: Supplier Beta has an approved qualification for the part.

cases.name: Alternate supplier not approved
cases.input: Supplier Beta is not approved for the part.
cases.expected: The alternate-source scenario is blocked with qualification evidence.

cases.name: Inventory available at another plant
cases.input: Another plant has sufficient usable inventory.
cases.expected: The transfer feasibility check returns true.

cases.name: No feasible mitigation
cases.expected: The scenario set reports no feasible mitigation.

cases.name: Premium freight above approval threshold
cases.input: Premium freight exceeds the configured finance threshold.

cases.name: Missing or stale collaboration evidence
cases.input: Qualification evidence is missing or older than the accepted age.
cases.expected: The evidence is classified as stale.
